integrity: An exact integer dual certificate is proved for order 30 and lifted algebraically for every dyadic multiple; standalone exact finite computations corroborate rather than establish the unrestricted theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only orders 30 times a power of two, with actual cyclotomic polynomial divisibility; this is not a classification of arbitrary real weighted cancellations at a single root. Independent audit not performed; historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp antipodal rigidity below two-thirds of a cyclotomic period
